notes: Introduces an original route-and-waypoint planner emblem and a friendlier product identity across the header, favicon, and dashboard. Rebalances the interface away from diagnostic-tool styling with softer layered surfaces, clearer typography, stronger section hierarchy, purpose-led cards, a visual build-completion ring, and simplified navigation. Build synchronization and the full equipment overview now collapse into focused drawers after a build loads, keeping the daily plan prominent while preserving every control. The generated logo is packaged as a required updater asset and verified by system health. Planner data and scan state are unchanged.
